symptom: under mdl 1, a loop-body change next to a genuinely changed statement (e.g. commit gains `without events`) is spliced as "1 replaced, 1 dropped" and rebuilds the loop with new $IDs; the same loop-body change alone is refused
cause: the sameLoopShell refusal was asked only of a 1:1 run of unmatched statements; a longer run went straight to replace
insight: A refusal that guards identity must be asked of every pairing in the run, not of the run's shape; what happens to change next to the guarded node decides the shape
